summary: Continued T101 attempt 1 in the existing worktree. The prior developer had already implemented every T101 deliverable: the boundary catalogue (DS-012), versioned feature registry (DS-010), forward-label schema (DS-011), deterministic splits (DS-020..DS-022), panel provenance with run/member/registry/legacy guards, the three model families (linear regularised, linear quantile, gradient-boosting) with diagnostics (calibration, quantile coverage, trivial baseline comparison) and versioned model artifacts (DS-040, DS-043), and the training harness that wires them. The continuation work was (1) re-verify that the implementation still passes the task-specific pytest suite (60/60), (2) confirm the layer-map, ruff, ruff-format and mypy gates pass, (3) apply a one-line ruff format nit the previous attempt left in src/robinhood_lp/research/harness.py (the elif line that ruff would have re-wrapped), (4) confirm the two pre-existing test failures on the base commit (forge oracle worktree and a T069 architecture-section22 citation) are not introduced by T101, and (5) sanity-check that a saved harness configuration re-runs to a byte-equivalent artifact. No new T101 functionality was added — the candidate was complete; the prior developer only needed a chance to verify and hand off.

residual_risks: Two pre-existing repository-wide failures (test_abi_artifacts forge oracle; test_documentation_citations architecture-section22 T069 finding) reproduce on the base commit a414ab7 and are not introduced by T101. They remain visible in `pytest` output and the reviewer may want to verify them out-of-band before approving.

run_fold_evaluation wraps the forward-feature registry re-check around a synthetic placeholder (rotates declarations by index) because the per-feature evaluation columns are not currently threaded through to the harness. The behaviour is conservative — it surfaces a real ForwardFeatureError when the snapshot genuinely carries one — but a future task that wires per-feature eval columns will tighten the gate further.

apply_split_to_panel uses an empty feature mapping; populate_fold synthesises empty PanelFeatureRow placeholders. T102 (model layer consumer) is expected to thread the real feature rows into the call; this candidate only proves the partition shape.
